title: ask/web Chrome launch: AppBotPipe focusless guard allowlist
desc: ChromeLauncher uses UseShellExecute=true+WindowStyle.Minimized so Chrome opens minimized (taskbar only, no focus theft). AppBotPipe.StartTracked's focusless guard used to block every Verb-less UseShellExecute, killing Chrome startup and breaking ask/web/triad paths. Guard now allowlists WindowStyle=Minimized/Hidden since they're inherently non-focus-stealing.
steps: AppBotPipe.StartTracked blocks UseShellExecute=true unless Verb=runas OR WindowStyle is Minimized/Hidden
ChromeLauncher uses UseShellExecute=true+WindowStyle.Minimized + --window-size/--window-position so Chrome starts minimized at known bounds
Focus stays on user's current app; CDP port 9222 comes up; ask/web/triad work without Chrome stealing foreground
If Chrome fails to launch again check the AppBotPipe guard logs for 'focusless violation' message

5. 2026-05-03 (commit 9db2e112): LaunchAsync now retries once after KillChromeOnPortAsync + KillStaleChromesAsync + 500ms profile-lock release on transient 'Chrome process exited' / 'CDP endpoint not ready' errors. Catches the BUG-AUTO cluster where a stale profile lock or slow renderer boot would propagate as InvalidOperationException up to ask/web callers.
